crosschecks.result: CORROBORATES archived wache-koenig.py sha256 7e64dd0daa19aff5a6e560de9e542bc5460cb6d230048cd72fb806e5a3b42d23 and freigabe sha256 23580136ed3f73bf8123a45c81ec98d3905f295c472ff748322ba8629a2c795d, plus the source-declared limits and one-shot command-bound ticket design
CORROBORATES owner-gate separation, command-hash binding, expiry/single-use lineage and a bounded non-destructive classifier replay; does not establish current runtime reachability

forensic_findings.claim: The archived wache-koenig.py is a genuine pre-execution blocking predecessor for selected Bash commands when installed in a PreToolUse scheduler: it returns a blocking exit for hard-deny classes and for ticket-required commands without a valid grant. It is not a complete cross-tool effect authority because non-Bash tools are intentionally outside its scope.
forensic_findings.migration: Keep the pre-execution enforcement position, retire Bash-only regex classification as canonical authority.

forensic_findings.claim: The archived gate consumes a one-shot ticket bound to the exact command hash; the companion freigabe path separates grant creation from model/tool execution through a controlling TTY and adds delay/expiry. This is a strong precursor to a typed owner/capability lease, but raw command text omits typed resource, resolved executable, cwd/environment, generation and causal identity.
forensic_findings.migration: Adapt the separation, one-shot consumption, scope binding and expiry into a typed EffectDecision/CapabilityLease; do not copy typing heuristics or raw-command authority.

forensic_findings.claim: The effect lineage contains distinct mechanisms rather than one continuously strengthening gate: historical Project-Frankenstein caller-side human approval, archived wache-koenig Bash enforcement, and current stern.py nonblocking admission/outcome journaling each preserve different useful properties and different gaps.
forensic_findings.migration: Frankenstein 2.0 must fuse typed pre-execution decision consumption with exact post-effect verification/journaling rather than naming any one donor mechanism as the finished EffectGate.

frankenstein2_effect_contract_delta.executor_rule: The actual execution boundary must atomically consume a matching one-shot EffectDecision/CapabilityLease before submission. Caller-controlled skip_approval, session-wide mutable pointers, journal labels, model output and owner-intent prose are not substitutes.
frankenstein2_effect_contract_delta.mismatch_rule: Any mismatch in invocation identity, request digest, generation, capability scope, resource identity, policy version or expiry fails closed before effect submission.
frankenstein2_effect_contract_delta.post_submission_rule: After submission, cancellation and outcome are distinct. Transport uncertainty becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified; never reinterpret it as CANCELLED and never blindly replay.
frankenstein2_effect_contract_delta.coverage_rule: All state-changing tool classes must converge on the same deterministic effect authority or carry an explicit typed exemption with narrower capabilities; a Bash-only gate is insufficient.

world_and_grid_reuse.rule: Treat capability/effect authority as typed metadata outside the vector plane. HCU/GRID/world-model outputs may propose an EffectRequest but cannot mint, widen or consume an owner capability lease on their own.
world_and_grid_reuse.negative_rule: A recalled historical approval method or vector similarity to an approved action never creates present authority.

contradictions.detail: Exact archived source and hash are recovered, but the exact scheduler/settings binding and ordering that made this snapshot live are not established by this run.
The historical gate intentionally covers Bash only; current evidence does not establish one equivalent deterministic gate for every non-Bash state-changing tool path.

required_regressions: parallel same-session effects cannot overwrite each other's decision identity
non-Bash mutating tools traverse the same effect authority
post-submission unknown outcome cannot be replayed as if cancelled
triggerword4_handoff.donor_fixture_reuse: Retain historical benign/delete/nested-shell/hard-deny cases as regression fixtures only; do not elevate regex classification into EntityOS authority.

next_exact_gate: Recover the exact historical/global hook scheduler registration and ordering for wache-koenig, then trace current realtime_gespraech function-call dispatch to prove whether every state-changing voice tool reaches the same typed successor effect boundary; keep runtime credit at zero until exact execution receipts exist.
